id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying an ambiguous column name from a stale view

review.posthog_relevance: Adds MSSQL warehouse ingestion error classification, treating ambiguous column names as non-retryable to prevent automatic retry of unfixable ingestion failures.
review.reason: Adds documentation and a test for MSSQL error 209, classifying it as non-retryable. While the implementation of the dictionary update is not supplied, the documentation and test establish the intended behavior and relevance to warehouse ingestion reliability. This warrants a Tier 1 score for the documented and tested behavior, despite the missing implementation hunk.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the dictionary update is not supplied, so the tier is assigned based on the documented and tested behavior rather than complete implementation. This does not prevent the assessment of relevance but limits confidence.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new error key or the updated non_retryable_errors dictionary, only the documentation and the test. Therefore, while the change is described and tested, the actual code modification is not supplied, preventing a complete assessment of tier and confidence.

observations.behavior: Adds documentation and a test for a new SQL Server error 209 ('Ambiguous column name') and its classification as a non-retryable error.
observations.code_quote: "Ambiguous column name": "A view you're syncing has a column name that exists in more than one of the tables it reads, so SQL Server can't resolve it. Fix or refresh the view definition at the source, then re-enable the sync.",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a new entry to the MSSQL source's error classification, treating ambiguous column names as non-retryable, requiring manual intervention rather than automatic retry.
